enrichment.headline: Approves up to $200,000 for SolarStorage Fund D to install and maintain a battery system at Castlemont High
enrichment.summary: SolarStorage Fund D, LLC, of Richmond, will install and maintain a battery storage system at Castlemont High School as part of an energy efficiency and safety project funded by Measure Y. The cost is capped at $200,000 for a term from March 9, 2023 to October 2, 2034, with up to five one-year extensions at fair market value. The Board also authorizes a filing that the project is exempt from review under the California Environmental Quality Act.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.sourceIssue: The text calls this a ten-year term but gives dates of March 9, 2023 through October 2, 2034, which is longer than ten years.

enrichment.headline: Ratifies transfer of the Oakland High battery construction contract from SunPower to TotalEnergies
enrichment.summary: SunPower Corporation's December 16, 2021 engineering, procurement and construction agreement for the Oakland High School battery project is being assigned to TotalEnergies Distributed Generation USA, LLC, a subsidiary of TotalEnergies Renewables USA. The text states no dollar amount for this assignment.

enrichment.headline: Adds $964,222 and a year to Anthonio's construction inspection work on the Cole Administration Center
enrichment.summary: This amendment extends the inspector of record services Anthonio, Inc. provides for the Cole Administration Center project. The added work covers plan review, monitoring special inspectors and closeout documents. It raises the contract limit from $731,578 to $1,695,800, and extends the end date from December 31, 2023 to December 31, 2024.
